(A) FROM clause: Identify the target table and execute joins
(B) WHERE clause: Filter individual tuples based on boolean conditions
(C) SELECT clause: Project requested attribute columns or expressions
(D) ORDER BY clause: Sort the resulting projected output rows

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

Logical query processing executes: FROM -> WHERE -> SELECT -> ORDER BY.
